// Envelope
// Fold the four corners of a square onto the center (blintz base),
// then lift the last flap back up to show it as an open envelope.
d 200 200
// Crease both diagonals to locate the center
by2d p0 p2
by2d p1 p3
// Fold each corner onto the center
across3d p0 p4
t 600 r s12 180 p0
across3d p1 p4
t 600 r s14 180 p1
across3d p2 p4
t 600 r s18 180 p2
across3d p3 p4
t 600 r s22 180 p3
// Show
iao
t 1000 tz 45
t 1000 ty 360
// Lift the last flap to look like an open envelope
t 800 r s22 -140 p3
iao
t 1000 fit
